entries.dialogueText: I waved out the car window to the crowds of citizens lining the road. Up ahead, the domed library of the university brought back memories -- first of my happy student years there, then of the horrifying way they'd ended.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I waved out the car window to the c..."
entries.dialogueText: I waved out the car window to the crowds of citizens lining the road. Up ahead loomed the domed library of the university.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The city's main road was straight a..."
entries.dialogueText: The city's main road was straight and impossibly wide, a relic of Markian times when the city was a major trading center.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Under Rico's stewardship, a formida..."
entries.dialogueText: Under Rico's stewardship, a formidable-looking iron gate had been constructed around the otherwise tranquil palace complex.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Welcome, my cousins! It has been f..."
entries.dialogueText: "Welcome, my cousins! It has been far too long."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We walked up to the doors. As soon..."
entries.dialogueText: We walked up to the doors. As soon as the guards opened them, a pair of long-nosed Rizian hunting dogs raced towards us, barking.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Go away! I hate dogs!""
entries.dialogueText: "Go away! I hate dogs!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I reached out and carefully gave ea..."
entries.dialogueText: I reached out and carefully gave each dog a pat on the head.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Easy there, puppies.""
entries.dialogueText: "Easy there, puppies."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Stay back, Vina. They might be dan..."
entries.dialogueText: "Stay back, Vina. They might be dangerous."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Both dogs promptly sat at attention..."
entries.dialogueText: Both dogs promptly sat at attention, still as statues.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I heard the sound of boots on tile..."
entries.dialogueText: I heard the sound of boots on tile as my cousin Rico approached. He was wearing an olive-green tweed jacket and a flat cap.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Greetings, Your Grace.""
entries.dialogueText: "Greetings, Your Grace."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So it has, Rico. You're looking sp..."
entries.dialogueText: "So it has, Rico. You're looking sporty."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Did Father not tell you? We're goi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Did Father not tell you? We're going hunting!"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Your first hunt as king. I wanted..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your first hunt as king. I wanted it to be a surprise."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo appeared from behind his son,..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo appeared from behind his son, a sheepish look on his face.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wish we were seeing each other u..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish we were seeing each other under more pleasant circumstances."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I enjoyed hunting with you as a ch..."
entries.dialogueText: "I enjoyed hunting with you as a child. But I prefer more intellectual pursuits now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A welcome surprise indeed. It's be..."
entries.dialogueText: "A welcome surprise indeed. It's been ages since I shot something."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You know how much I love hunting...."
entries.dialogueText: "You know how much I love hunting. But I wanted to have a serious discussion."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You could've warned us about the c..."
entries.dialogueText: "You could've warned us about the canine welcoming committee."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Bella and Bruno wouldn't hurt a fl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Bella and Bruno wouldn't hurt a fly. They're just overexcited about today's hunt."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""What do you mean? An afternoon in..."
entries.dialogueText: "What do you mean? An afternoon in the woods killing boars sounds like the definition of pleasant to me."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I trust Father informed you of tod..."
entries.dialogueText: "I trust Father informed you of today's plans? We leave for the woods in an hour."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I appreciate it. But I was hoping..."
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate it. But I was hoping the four of us could have a serious conversation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You know me too well. Let's go sho..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know me too well. Let's go shoot something!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's a barbaric sport. I prefer mo..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a barbaric sport. I prefer more intellectual pursuits."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""We'll have plenty of chances for t..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll have plenty of chances for that. Nine-tenths of this sport is waiting, after all."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Hunting requires a keen eye and a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hunting requires a keen eye and a keener mind. Done properly, it's the most intellectual pursuit there is."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Not when you have this.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not when you have this."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""You'll be glad to know the technol..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'll be glad to know the technology has greatly improved since then."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He turned around and showed us the..."
entries.dialogueText: He turned around and showed us the KA-74 automatic rifle strapped to his back. Hugo turned up his nose disapprovingly.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Isn't that cheating?""
entries.dialogueText: "Isn't that cheating?"

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Boars are speedy bastards. You'd b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Boars are speedy bastards. You'd be surprised, Your Highness."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He smiled rakishly at my daughter."
entries.dialogueText: He smiled rakishly at my daughter.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""You're behind the times, Father. W..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're behind the times, Father. Who needs a keen mind when you have this?"

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""As His Majesty proclaims, so it sh..."
entries.dialogueText: "As His Majesty proclaims, so it shall be!"

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I'm already equipped, myself.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm already equipped, myself."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""We have outfits prepared for the t..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have outfits prepared for the two of you. And your choice of weapons, of course."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I want a KA-74, same as Rico.""
entries.dialogueText: "I want a KA-74, same as Rico."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It'll be a good old-fashioned rifl..."
entries.dialogueText: "It'll be a good old-fashioned rifle for me."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""See, Father? We'll have bagged a d..."
entries.dialogueText: "See, Father? We'll have bagged a dozen boars before you've even finished loading."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You see, boy, there are still real..."
entries.dialogueText: "You see, boy, there are still real gentlemen in this world."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo smirked at his son."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo smirked at his son.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Inside, Vina and I quickly refreshe..."
entries.dialogueText: Inside, Vina and I quickly refreshed ourselves and changed into the hunting garb that had been laid out for us. We stepped out to find two waiting jeeps.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I turned away from the window to se..."
entries.dialogueText: I turned away from the window to see Rico looking at me intently.

entries.dialogueText: "Don't forget to whom you are speaking, Duke Toras. Count yourself lucky I haven't ordered your arrest yet."

entries.dialogueText: "Of course, of course. Forgive me."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Trust me, nobody I know has a clue..."
entries.dialogueText: "Trust me, nobody I know has a clue who was behind the Zille attack."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't need names. The investigat..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't need names. The investigation will turn up the truth."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A bold suggestion, Your Grace.""
entries.dialogueText: "A bold suggestion, Your Grace."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Would you expect anything less of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Would you expect anything less of the Duke of Iza?"

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""The drugs, the violence, the open..."
entries.dialogueText: "The drugs, the violence, the open resistance against our government."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I wanted to thank you for your und..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wanted to thank you for your understanding, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I turned away from the window to se..."
entries.dialogueText: I turned away from the window to see my cousin smiling at me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Just between us... did Su Omina pl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just between us... did Su Omina plan the attack?"

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""That's the funny thing. Nobody I'v..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's the funny thing. Nobody I've spoken to has a clue who did it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A false flag if I ever saw one. We..."
entries.dialogueText: "A false flag if I ever saw one. Wehlen obviously planned the bombing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No need to thank me. I was protect..."
entries.dialogueText: "No need to thank me. I was protecting myself as well."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What choice did I have? Members of..."
entries.dialogueText: "What choice did I have? Members of our house must stand by each other."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Killing a few of their own means n..."
entries.dialogueText: "Killing a few of their own means nothing to them. They're like ants."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Have you no compassion, son? Those..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have you no compassion, son? Those are human beings who died."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Halaita. If it is said, so it is.""
entries.dialogueText: "Halaita. If it is said, so it is."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Watch your mouth. It's that kind o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Watch your mouth. It's that kind of language that made Wehlen suspect Su Omina in the first place."

entries.dialogueText: "Hugo's meeting us here too, right? Why do you think they wanted us here so badly?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I have my guesses. We'll see if they're right."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "To see something like those statues, I wager. Give us an inkling of the pressure Rico is under."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "The family hasn't been all together in ages. It's about time."

entries.dialogueText: "Never mind, then."

entries.dialogueText: Rico nodded solemnly.

Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Then we have an understanding."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: Rico eagerly turned back toward me.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I'm sure you've been kept abreast..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure you've been kept abreast of the situation here, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The headless statues.""
entries.dialogueText: "The headless statues."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're not a child, Rico. Pull you..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're not a child, Rico. Pull yourself together and become the leader this city needs."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It doesn't seem that bad to me.""
entries.dialogueText: "It doesn't seem that bad to me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's concerning indeed. What can I..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's concerning indeed. What can I do to help?"

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""You weren't supposed to see those.""
entries.dialogueText: "You weren't supposed to see those."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I'm trying. But I can't do it with..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm trying. But I can't do it without reinforcements."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Sooner or later, it will add up to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sooner or later, it will add up to something greater than its parts."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I'm glad you asked.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm glad you asked."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I've heard that in times of emerge..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've heard that in times of emergency, police from the Rizian central forces can be placed under individual leaders' direct command."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I've petitioned your War and Secur..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've petitioned your War and Security Councilor for just such a transfer, but she refused."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rightly so. You should be cooperat..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rightly so. You should be cooperating with the greater province of Brenas."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So you're using your family connec..."
entries.dialogueText: "So you're using your family connections to go over her head."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""She made a mistake. The Brenas pol..."
entries.dialogueText: "She made a mistake. The Brenas police cannot be counted on to help you keep the peace here."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""You mean with the Sazons?""
entries.dialogueText: "You mean with the Sazons?"

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Well... yes. I don't see another a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well... yes. I don't see another alternative."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""If anything, they are actively wor..."
entries.dialogueText: "If anything, they are actively working against me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He snorted."
entries.dialogueText: He snorted.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""They can't be counted on to cooper..."
entries.dialogueText: "They can't be counted on to cooperate. If anything, they're actively plotting against us."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""You understand that this city is a..."
entries.dialogueText: "You understand that this city is a bellwether for our house. If we lose it, we lose Rizia."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I'll send you the petition when we..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll send you the petition when we are both back home. I trust you to do what's best for our city."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I know the Wehzeks were pressuring..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know the Wehzeks were pressuring you to denounce Su Omina. You very wisely saw their witch hunt for what it was."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Although we weren't sorry to hear..."
entries.dialogueText: "Although we weren't sorry to hear those Wehzeks got what was coming to them."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: Rico smirked.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I will let you in on a secret, tho..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will let you in on a secret, though."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm not sure I believe that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not sure I believe that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's clearly a ruse planned by the..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's clearly a ruse planned by the Wehzeks themselves."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They're upstanding citizens. I can..."
entries.dialogueText: "They're upstanding citizens. I can't imagine they would stoop to violence."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras

entries.dialogueText: "No, sir."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""You don't have to. But I'm telling..."
entries.dialogueText: "You don't have to. But I'm telling you the truth."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras

entries.dialogueText: "It's just us here in this car, isn't it? We can tell it like it is."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Speaking of which... I'll let you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Speaking of which... I'll let you in on a secret."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Just prior to the incident, we wer..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just prior to the incident, we were about to activate a branch of Su Omina in Zille."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""They'll be exposed soon enough. Th..."
entries.dialogueText: "They'll be exposed soon enough. They aren't intelligent enough to cover their own tracks."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He glanced at me conspiratorially."
entries.dialogueText: He glanced at me conspiratorially.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope you're not still planning o..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you're not still planning on going through with that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What do you mean, 'activate?'""
entries.dialogueText: "What do you mean, 'activate?'"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That would have been an idiotic th..."
entries.dialogueText: "That would have been an idiotic thing to do without the King's permission."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To what end, precisely?""
entries.dialogueText: "To what end, precisely?"

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Why shouldn't we?""
entries.dialogueText: "Why shouldn't we?"

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Smolak was never going to hand Zil..."
entries.dialogueText: "Smolak was never going to hand Zille over on a silver platter. We'll only get back what's ours if we put the screws to him."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I can't condone this, Rico."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Define 'mess with.'""
entries.dialogueText: "Define 'mess with.'"

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
